blurb: A city of trade fairs and music, where Bach worked for 27 years.

facts.t: Bach was cantor of St Thomas Church from 1723 until he died in 1750, writing a new cantata almost every week for years. His grave has been in the church since 1950.
Felix Mendelssohn, who led the Gewandhaus orchestra here, conducted the St Matthew Passion in Berlin in 1829, the first time since Bach's death, and started the Bach revival.
